verses.1: These are the words that Moses spoke to all of Israel across the Jordan River, in the desert between Paran and Tsephath. It was at sunset when he said these words.
verses.2: Eleven days after the destruction of Mount Seir, they reached Kadesh Barnea.
verses.3: In the forty years, on the tenth day of the month of Adar, Moses spoke to the children of Israel, just as Jehovah had commanded him to do.
verses.4: After that, he announced the death of King Sihon, who ruled in Hesbón. He also announced the death of King Og, who ruled in Edrei.
verses.5: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses received this Torah.
verses.6: Yehová, our God, has spoken to us in a dream. He said, “You shall dwell on that mountain.”
verses.7: Go and journey to the Amorite land, and to all its inhabitants. Go in the darkness of the mountains, in the desolation, on the slopes, and by the shore of the sea. This is the land of the Canaanites and the Libans, all the way up to the great river, the River Euphrates.
verses.8: See, I have given you this land. You may go and possess it. This land was promised by the LORD to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, so that they and their descendants could inherit it.
verses.9: And he said to you at that time, “I cannot carry you alone.”
verses.10: YHWH, your God, has increased your numbers today. You are now as numerous as the stars in the sky.
verses.11: The LORD, your God, will gather you together again, just as He did before. He will bless you, just as He has promised to do.
verses.12: How I will bear the burden of your efforts, your suffering, and your hatred towards me.
verses.13: I have given you men who are wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable, so that they may rule over you. I will bring them back to their rightful place.
verses.14: They answered me by saying, “Good is what you have said to do.”
verses.15: And I will take the leaders of your tribes—men who are wise and knowledgeable. I will give them positions of authority over you. They will be chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties, chiefs of tens, and rulers over your tribes.
verses.16: And I command your judges at that time to say: “Hear between your brothers, and judge fairly between one man and his brother, and between a man and his neighbor.”
verses.17: Do not judge people by their outward appearance, whether they are small or great. Do not be afraid of anyone’s judgment. For judgment belongs to God. It is difficult for you to understand this, but come to me and listen to it.
verses.18: And I command you at that time to do all the things that you are to do.
verses.19: And we traveled from Jericho. We crossed all that vast and beautiful desert. That desert you saw when you went up the Mount Hermon, as God our Lord commanded us to do. And we continued our journey until we reached the Holy Land.
verses.20: And he said to you, “You have come to the Mount of Hermon, which Jehovah our God has given us.”
verses.21: See, the LORD your God has given you this land as a gift before your eyes. It is a land full of resources, just as the LORD, your God, said through your ancestors. Do not be afraid, and do not despair.
verses.22: And they all came to me, and said, “Send men before us. They will explore the land for us, and they will guide us along the path we must take, and also show us the cities we must enter.”
verses.23: And it pleased me, and I will take from you twelve men, one for each tribe.
verses.24: And they turned around and climbed up the mountain. They went all the way to the stream of Eshkol, and there they lay down.
verses.25: And they took some of the fruit from the land, and brought it to us. They said, “Good is this land, which Jehovah our God has given us.”
verses.26: And they did not build them to be used as a place of worship; instead, they filled it with idols. Thus, Jehovah your God became angry with you.
verses.27: And they were brought into your camps, and they said in the name of Jehovah, “You have brought us out of Egypt, but you will hand us over to the Amorites so that they may destroy us.”
verses.28: We are rising up, my brothers. Our hearts are filled with pride. We see great and magnificent cities in the heavens, as well as giants who live there.
verses.29: And he said to you, “Do not be afraid of them, nor despise them.”
verses.30: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you against all those things that He did to you in Egypt, right before your eyes.
verses.31: And in the desert you saw that Jehovah your God carried you along with Him, just as a father carries his child along every path you traveled until you reached this place.
verses.32: And in this statement, you do not believe in your God.
verses.33: Let him go before you, so that you may have a place to rest during the night. Let you see the path you will take along it, and in the clouds of that day.
verses.34: And Jehovah heard the sound of their voices. He became angry and said, “No!”
verses.35: If anyone sees these people, this evil time, and the good land that I have promised to give to your ancestors…
verses.36: My dog is a beautiful puppy. I will give him the land that it walks on, and also give it its children, because they are born after Jehovah’s command.
verses.37: Also, Jehovah angered against you, saying, “You also shall not enter there.”
verses.38: Jehoshaphat, son of Nehushon, who stands before you, will come and strengthen Israel. For he will bring deliverance to Israel.
verses.39: And those of you who said that they would be saved, but who today do not know what is good or evil, will come before Me. And I will give them their reward. They will inherit it.
verses.40: And you shall go forth into the sea, along the coast of the Sea of Suhuf.
verses.41: They replied, “We have sinned against Jehovah. We will go up and fight against all those whom Jehovah, our God, has commanded us to do. Then each man will take his weapons and go up to the mountain.”
verses.42: And the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up, and do not fight against them. For I am not with you in this battle. Do not be defeated before your enemies.”
verses.43: And I will speak to you, but you will not listen. The mouth of the LORD will become stubborn, and it will rise up against me.
verses.44: And the Amorite who lived in that mountain went out to meet you. He pursued you as soon as you did what was commanded by God. He chased you with his army until they reached Harom.
verses.45: And they wept and mourned before Jehovah. But Jehovah did not hear their cries, nor did He listen to them at all.
verses.46: And they shall dwell in holiness for many days, just as you will also dwell there.
